resources.string: Connect the pendant directly to this phone with a USB data cable (OTG if needed). Keep its battery connected.\n\nTap Pair, allow USB and Nearby devices, and keep the cable connected until pairing is confirmed. Android may show its own pairing prompt.
Enable Bluetooth, then tap Pair again.
Connect exactly one pendant using a data cable. The phone must be the USB host.
Allow this app to access the wired pendant.
